thread:
incident-bot: Pager duty triggered: metering-emit-anomaly (P2) — runbook /runbooks/metering-emit. Initial alert: high shadow counts + delayed commits.
eng-oncall: taking this. pinging SRE and Billing.
alice_sre: seeing a steady lag on consumer group `meter-emitter-cg` — offsets not committing for ~9m. graph: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/token-emit-lag 
alice_sre: log tail: ```[2026-03-15T08:22:10Z] emitter: batch flushed size=0, queued=1278
[2026-03-15T08:23:02Z] kafka-consumer: fetch_empty, offset=2451, retries=3
[2026-03-15T08:24:01Z] reconciler: shadow_count +18% vs expected```
bob_billing: we're seeing a burst of overage flags for a small set of customers — looks correlated with the emit lag window 08:10–08:25 UTC. list attached.
carol_platform: is this the same as the prefix-caching retry we rolled yesterday? any config drift?
alice_sre: config shows the recent change to consumer concurrency didn't apply on two zones (eu-west-1a, us-west-2b). probably the cause — consumers starved, queue grew, emitter returned partial batches.
matt_infra: I can push the concurrency fix to the missing zones now. will do a rolling deploy to `meter-emitter` replicas. ETA ~6m.
eng-oncall: do that. also prepare a fallback route to the secondary emitter (low-cost, slower) if deploy fails.
alice_sre: running quick check: ```kubectl get deploy meter-emitter -o yaml | grep -A2 replicas``` shows replicas: 6 in eu-west-1a (expected 8). patching.
matt_infra: patch applied to eu-west-1a and us-west-2b. watching.
alice_sre: offsets resuming commit in eu-west-1a — backlog draining, queued from 1278 -> 420 in 3m.
bob_billing: confirm: overage flag rate dropping in those customers. still some delayed usage records queued; we probably emitted duplicates for a handful of tokens during the window.
dave_custsuccess: flagged three customers who got email overage notices. drafting a hold-and-investigate message: "We're investigating unexpected usage notifications; please ignore while we reconcile. No billing adjustments yet." Want approval to pause outbound notices until we reconcile?
bob_billing: yes please pause notices for impacted accounts. I'll start a shadow-recon job to diff emitted tokens vs ledger and prepare proposed credits.
carol_platform: recommend a short-lived rollback of the change that caused the concurrency mismatch if we see recurrence after drain.
alice_sre: drain completed in eu-west-1a and us-west-2b, global queue down to 40. kafka lag back to normal.
bob_billing: running `shadow_recon --start 2026-03-15T08:00 --end 2026-03-15T08:30 --out /tmp/recon-1829994321.csv` — will upload results in ~10m. initial diff shows 0.08% inflation across all customers, concentrated in 7 accounts.
dave_custsuccess: copied. I'll hold notices and send templated note to those 7 with: "We're reviewing an alerts issue — if you received an overage notice, please hold off. We're reconciling now and will follow up."
matt_infra: quick note: emitter pods show OOM kill 2/3 on older node pool during the window; autoscaler didn't spin up due to a label mismatch — opened infra-issue #INC-482. patching node labels.\eng-oncall: summary for pager handoff: root cause: partial rollout left 2 zones with lower consumer concurrency + nodepool label mismatch causing OOMs => emit backlog => transient overage flags. Mitigation: patched deployments, patched node labels, paused customer notices, shadow recon started.\alice_sre: rollout verification: 100% of zones now at expected replica/concurrency. no recurrence in last 20m.\bob_billing: recon results attached: `recon-1829994321.csv` (7 accounts, total 12,420 tokens duplicated). recommending automated credits for those 7 accounts and cancel outbound notices.\dave_custsuccess: approved message to customers. ready to send once billing confirms credits.\obvious-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: added to message by bob_billing.\eng-oncall: action items: 1) Billing to apply credits for 7 accounts (bob) 2) CS to hold and message (dave) 3) Infra to finalize node label fix + postmortem (matt) 4) SRE to add a runbook checkpoint for verifying zone parity on rollouts (alice).\bob_billing: starting credit job now. I will post tx ids and amounts.\matt_infra: node labels patched, autoscaler behavior back to normal. will open CL to add rollout verification to CI.\alice_sre: adding runbook note and a Grafana alert to fail fast on consumer concurrency parity.\eng-oncall: handing off to next oncall in 30m — no active regression, customer-impact limited and being remediated. closing pager in 2h unless new alerts.\dave_custsuccess: final customer note queued, will send after credits applied.\bob_billing: credits applied for 7 accounts: tx_ids [tx_6221, tx_6222, tx_6223, tx_6224, tx_6225, tx_6226, tx_6227]. amounts totaled and in ticket #INC-482-billing.\alice_sre: follow-up: we'll run a full backfill dedupe for any late records; will post results here when done.\eng-oncall: thanks team — good mitigation. closing thread once postmortem is up. :thumbsup:
